name: wm
description: WhiteMagic meta-tool — memory and continuity kernel over the curated tool surface (69 tools): persistent memory, session continuity and recall, governance/audit, and local tool execution.

args.description: Arguments to pass through to the target tool.

route.description: Explicit tool name for direct dispatch (e.g. 'memory.create', 'tools.list').

thought.description: Natural language input describing what to do. Auto-routes to the best-matching tool via TF-IDF NLU classification.

title: WhiteMagic memory and continuity meta-tool

outputSchema.description: The dispatched tool's result envelope plus `_wm_route` dispatch metadata; fields vary by route.

_wm_route.description: Dispatch metadata: resolved tool, routing confidence, matched input.

input.description: Routing input that produced the match

name: memory.create
description: Store a new memory in the holographic memory core with 5D spatial coordinates and galaxy routing.

importance.description: Optional importance 0.0-1.0 (write gate applies class ceilings/floors when the class is recognized)

source.description: Authorship claim: user (user-dictated content, trust 1.0) | agent (default, trust 0.7) | other free-form class (trust 0.7)

topic.description: Optional topic label for subject-scoped retrieval (envelope v2)

title: Create memory

outputSchema.description: Creation receipt for the stored memory.

attested.description: Whether a record attestation was attached

attested_reason.description: Why attestation was skipped when it was not attached

source_trust.description: Trust weight recorded for the authorship class

name: memory.search
description: Search and recall memories across galaxies using hybrid semantic, BM25, and associative retrieval.

cold_scan_limit.description: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

galaxy.description: Galaxy filter (optional; default: search all memory galaxies, results labeled; "all" is accepted as an alias for the unfiltered default)

include_cold.description: Opt-in unranked cold recovery (no thaw). Trust/importance floors apply; BM25 floors do not apply to unscored recovery. Search content is scrubbed navigation capped at 8192 characters; read by id/galaxy for the exact original.

min_score_ratio.description: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

min_trust.description: Minimum source_trust (0-1): drop results below this trust floor

title: Search memories

outputSchema.description: Ranked recall results with an evidence bundle and recall-mode disclosure.

evidence_bundle.description: Per-result provenance (coverage, history, integrity, retrieval, source_time, visibility) plus conflicts.

galaxy.description: Galaxy scope the query ran against

hint.description: Optional recovery hint when results are thin

recall_mode.description: Retrieval path used (hybrid, episodic, fts, importance, none)

results.description: Ranked memories (id, content, score, galaxy, source)

name: memory.read
description: Retrieve a specific memory by its ID or coordinate address.
title: Read memory

outputSchema.description: The exact stored memory record.

name: memory.list
description: List memories with filters (galaxy, tags, limit, offset) for inventory and discovery.

exclude_tags.description: Drop memories carrying any of these tags

offset.description: Skip this many matching entries before returning (default 0)

title: List memories

outputSchema.description: A page of memory records with pagination counters.

name: memory.hybrid_recall
description: Fused recall across full-text, vector, graph, and coordinate lookup with recall_mode disclosure.

cold_scan_limit.description: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

galaxy.description: Galaxy filter (optional; default: search all memory galaxies, results labeled; "all" is accepted as an alias for the unfiltered default)

include_cold.description: Opt-in unranked cold recovery (no thaw). Trust/importance floors apply; BM25 floors do not apply to unscored recovery. Search content is scrubbed navigation capped at 8192 characters; read by id/galaxy for the exact original.

min_score_ratio.description: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

min_trust.description: Minimum source_trust (0-1): drop results below this trust floor

title: Hybrid recall

outputSchema.description: Fused recall results with an evidence bundle and recall-mode disclosure.

evidence_bundle.description: Per-result provenance (coverage, history, integrity, retrieval, source_time, visibility) plus conflicts.

galaxy.description: Galaxy scope the query ran against

hint.description: Optional recovery hint when results are thin

recall_mode.description: Retrieval path used (hybrid, episodic, fts, importance, none)

results.description: Ranked memories with per-result source labels

name: session.record
description: Record a session turn (decision, breakthrough, summary) so the next session can resume.

supersedes.description: Memory id of an earlier turn this record corrects/replaces (amend-with-supersede)

track.description: Optional track slug (lowercase; a-z0-9 start, then a-z0-9-_. /) — tags this turn into that track's implementation log (session.track_log)

title: Record a session turn

outputSchema.description: Receipt for the recorded turn.

memory_id.description: Memory UUID of the stored turn

name: session.continuity
description: Recall where the previous session left off: recent turns, checkpoints, and open work.

max_content_bytes.description: Per-turn content cap in bytes (256-262144, default 8192)

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

title: Recall session continuity

outputSchema.description: Recent turns plus the latest checkpoint handoff for the prior session.

checkpoint_id.description: Memory UUID of the checkpoint, or null

previous_session.description: Session the turns were read from

truncated.description: Whether the response hit its byte budget

turns.description: Turns (memory_id, role, turn_type, sequence, content, content_bytes, content_truncated, importance)

turns_omitted.description: Turns dropped by the response budget

name: session.start
description: Start or resume an agent session for persistent continuity across tool invocations.
title: Start or resume a session

outputSchema.description: Session identity for the started or resumed session.

session_id.description: Session UUID to pass to record/checkpoint

user.description: User identifier the session belongs to

name: memory.update
description: Update an existing memory in place (content, tags, importance, title, topic); a content change appends to the memory's revision chain.
title: Update memory

outputSchema.description: Update receipt for the modified memory.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the content after the update

name: memory.revisions
description: List or verify a memory's content revision chain (tamper evidence): every content update is chained and head-checked.
title: Memory revision chain

outputSchema.description: Revision chain for a memory (newest first).

revisions.description: Revision records with content hashes and timestamps

name: session.checkpoint
description: Save a structured checkpoint (git state, next queue, open flags) so the next session can resume exactly here.

branch.description: Manual branch name (auto-captured when git is available)

commit.description: Manual commit hash (auto-captured from git when root/WM_PROJECT_ROOT is set)

data.description: Legacy free-form passthrough stored beside the handoff.

lease_id.description: Claimed scope (code.claim lease_id) that remains held at this handoff

next_queue.description: Ordered next-step strings for the next session.

open_flags.description: Open concerns/flags worth surfacing on resume.

root.description: Repository root for auto git-capture (default: WM_PROJECT_ROOT env)

tests_green.description: Whether the test suite was green at checkpoint time.

track.description: Optional track slug — tags this checkpoint into that track's log (session.track_log)

title: Save a session checkpoint

outputSchema.description: Checkpoint receipt with the stored structured handoff.

handoff.description: Structured handoff (next_queue, open_flags, git, tests_green, lease_id) as supplied.

name: memory.ingest
description: Harvest a folder of documents or session transcripts into the store (idempotent via a SHA-256 ledger; dry-run and redaction on by default).

dry_run.description: Report without writing or creating the store (default true).

include_credential_files.description: Ingest credential-named files with redaction (requires redact=true).

limit.description: Only consider the first N files in walk order (0 = all).

redact.description: Scrub credential-shaped content before storage (default true).

wait_secs.description: Wait up to N seconds for a busy store before failing.

title: Ingest documents into memory

outputSchema.description: Ingest report for the source folder.

redactions.description: Files whose credential-shaped spans were redacted

store.description: Store path that received the chunks

summary.description: One-line human summary of the run

name: receipts.emit
description: Emit a signed continuity receipt (Ed25519 did:key): session evidence or a karma-chain-head attestation, verifiable offline.

out.description: Optional path to also write the bundle JSON for external verification

session_id.description: Session UUID (session kind; default: most recent session)

title: Emit a continuity receipt

outputSchema.description: Continuity receipt emission receipt.

digest.description: sha256: digest of the signed bundle

memory_id.description: Memory UUID the receipt was stored as

name: receipts.verify
description: Verify a stored receipt id or a bundle offline; fail-closed without an anchor (verdict PROVISIONAL).

bundle.description: Inline bundle to verify (alternative to id)

id.description: Stored receipt task id (UUID or urn:uuid:)

require_anchor.description: Fail-closed: without an anchor the verdict is PROVISIONAL

title: Verify a continuity receipt

outputSchema.description: Verification report for a receipt or bundle.

require_anchor.description: Whether an external anchor was required

result.description: Verdict detail: errors, insufficient/provisional reasons, and a summary (attestations, issuers, receipts, settled, terminated, types).

name: memory.count
description: Count memories matching optional filters without returning content.

galaxy.description: Galaxy to count (optional; all memory galaxies when absent)

title: Count memories

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.stats
description: Memory-store statistics: totals, galaxy spread, and index health.
title: Memory statistics

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.tags
description: List the tag vocabulary with usage counts.

galaxy.description: Galaxy whose tags to list (optional; default codex)

title: List memory tags

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.aggregate
description: Aggregate a numeric or categorical field over matched memories.

query.description: Full-text query selecting the memories to aggregate over

title: Aggregate memories

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.associations
description: Associative neighbours of a memory (spreading activation over the association graph).
title: Memory associations

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.batch_read
description: Read several memories by id in one call.
title: Batch read memories

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.query
description: Structured query over memories with filters and ordering.

created_after.description: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z)

created_before.description: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over content (literal match). For tokenized, ranked full-text retrieval use memory.search

tags.description: Filter: memories with all of these tags

title: Query memories

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.filter
description: Filter memories by metadata (tags, importance, recency).

created_after.description: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z)

created_before.description: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

exclude_tags.description: Filter: drop memories carrying any of these tags

offset.description: Skip this many matching entries before returning (default 0)

query.description: Filter: every whitespace-separated term must appear (case-insensitive) in the content or title

tags.description: Filter: memories with all of these tags

title: Filter memories

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.nearby
description: Memories near a coordinate address (5D spatial neighbourhood).

query.description: Query text to locate in 5D space

title: Nearby memories

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: memory.vector.search
description: Vector-similarity search over memory embeddings.

memory_id.description: Memory UUID whose stored embedding is the query

title: Vector search memories

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: session.list
description: List sessions with titles and summaries.
title: List sessions

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: session.recall
description: Recall a session's turns without continuity packaging.

session_id.description: Session UUID to recall (defaults to the most recent session)

title: Recall a session

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: session.replay
description: Replay a session's recorded turns in order.

include_superseded.description: Also return turns replaced via supersedes (default false).

page_size.description: Lossless mode records per page (1-64, default 16)

session_id.description: Target session (required explicit UUID for lossless; otherwise default most recent)

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

turn_types.description: Selective mode: turn types to keep

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

title: Replay a session

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: gnosis.status
description: Knowledge-surface status: galaxies, counts, and index health.
title: Knowledge status

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

name: gnosis.explain
description: Explain why a memory or route was selected (provenance readout).

args_hash.description: Hash of the arguments under evaluation

has_purpose.description: Claim: the invocation carries a purpose

is_network.description: Claim: the invocation uses the network

is_spawn.description: Claim: the invocation spawns a process

title: Explain provenance

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.
